title: Lenovo reports Q2 revenue up 48% YoY to $30.2B and a $640M net loss vs. $38M est., amid rising PC component costs; it posted its first operating loss since 2017 (Yuan Gao/Bloomberg)
summary: Yuan Gao / Bloomberg: Lenovo reports Q2 revenue up 48% YoY to $30.2B and a $640M net loss vs. $38M est., amid rising PC component costs; it posted its first operating loss since 2017 — Lenovo Group Ltd. reported a far larger-than-anticipated loss for the September quarter, reflecting accounting charges and the mounting cost of PC components.
